sql:
SELECT ((a.overall_rating - e.overall_rating) / e.overall_rating * 100) AS percentage_difference
FROM Player_Attributes a
JOIN Player p ON a.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
JOIN Player q ON q.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
JOIN Player_Attributes e ON e.player_fifa_api_id = q.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
LIMIT 1
